description: Two units whose lossless component is its sync word and four bytes, so the data ends inside its header.
findings: ends inside the XLL component's header

skip.ffprobe_profile: ffmpeg's decoder sets the profile itself when it has decoded a frame (dca_core.c, dca_xll.c), and DTS-HD Master Audio or DTS-HD High Resolution Audio only after it has decoded the extension, which the stub components do not allow
skip.decode: ffmpeg rejects the XLL stub, a common header followed by filler, for its missing channel set sub-header (dca_xll.c: 'Invalid XLL sub-header checksum')
